sentences.text: 2 08-11-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Gardanibagh P.S. Case No. 482 of 2021,
instituted for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 323, 504, 506, 379, 498A of the Indian Penal Code and  of Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Petitioner is the husband of informant.

4. Issue notice to the opposite party no. 2 under registered cover with A/D as well as through ordinary process for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week after Chhath Puja holidays.
5.

The case be listed upon the receipt of service report Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.66182 of 2023(2) dt.08-11-2023 or appearance of the opposite party no. 2, whichever is earlier among the top five cases.
